claimsToVerify: The berbalang is a creature of Cagayan Sulu folklore whose spirit is said to leave its sleeping body at night to hunt
British officer Ethelbert Forbes Skelton published a 19th-century account of the berbalang based on testimony collected from islanders
In the lore, the berbalang's moaning is said to sound loud when it is far away and faint when it is near; coconut vinegar and a blade placed by its sleeping body are the traditional defence
